lines.t: Hear and seek to understand...
The Word of God is fire...
Each word, a burning flame...
Yeah, I move through the smoke and the sound,
Spirit burnin’ deep, can’t put me down.
Flame in the heart, light in the dark,
Every breath I take ignite that spark.
Waves roll heavy, basslines deep,
Holy visions, no soul asleep.
Through the flame, the truth I keep,
YAHUWAH eternal, His fire complete.
Flame within a flame, I ride that wave,
Infinite light, no soul to save.
YahuWah reigns, His name, One name,
The fire consumes — we rise from the flame.
Countenance glowin’, no shade remain,
Purified pain, baptized in rain.
YahuShua lead me through that fire,
The Holy Flame lift me higher, higher.
Creation spins in that holy storm,
Eternal form, no end, no norm.
All must pass through the purging blaze,
Lose the world, find holy ways.
Flame within a flame, I ride that wave,
Infinite light, no soul to save.
YahuWah reigns, His name, One name,
The fire consumes — we rise from the flame.
Whoa... the fire don’t end,
Whoa... beginning and end.
Within the flame, the Son remain,
Purifying hearts through holy pain.
Hear and seek, understand the fire,
Burn within, lift me higher.
YahuWah is One... YahuWah is One...
Flame in a flame, and the fire lives on.
